TC-09/S04.title: Supervisor-list photo with 2 known and 2 new residents: counts first, all four on Today's Visits, known data kept, new ones Follow-up
TC-09/S04.detail: Local, rst-tc09-scans.spec.ts: the real Nursing Home scan sheet with ai/vision:scanCensusSheet answered at the Convex socket with the exact rows the case's photo lists (the photo is a neutral fixture image; the read itself — Vertex / B01 — is not exercised); fresh physician per case, names 'QA TC-09-Sxx <word>' as the matrix asks. Open questions recorded, never judged (brief 2026-10-16): Q1 (the scan replaces today's list), Q6 (a row with no MRN is stored with a generated 'SNF-######' MRN), Q8 (a known name with another MRN), Q2 (count wording). T2 / U9 (Vertex Gemini read the photo; model and AI time logged) cannot be checked locally: the read never reaches the server; the 10-15 dev photo10 run logged them (gemini-3.6-flash, providerMs) but every live read returns no rows (B01, still on 25acd727: convex/ai/vision.ts + convex/lib/modelJson.ts parseModelJson unchanged, no fence stripping, Vertex has no JSON mode). S04: 16/16 judged pass — sheet '4 residents found' and '2 already in All Residents · 2 new · 0 to review' before anything is written (backend unchanged at that point); after 'Add 4 to Today's Visits' Alder, Birch, Dahlia and Elm are on Today's Visits and in All Residents, each exactly once; Alder keeps unit Oak 1A, its MRN, New Admission and its Important Point (card, backend and chart); Dahlia and Elm are Follow-up with the photo's units and no DOB; no Hospital patient in Nursing Home. Recorded: Q6 — Dahlia and Elm were stored with generated MRNs (SNF-443084, SNF-623195) shown on their charts; Q1 — the fixture resident (In Today, not on the photo) left Today's Visits without a prompt (judged in S08's frame, recorded).
